svg.title: Azure Databricks pipeline: file format at each stage
svg.desc: Source Parquet files are ingested with Auto Loader into Bronze Parquet, cleaned into Silver Delta tables, modelled into a Gold Delta star schema and served through a Databricks SQL Warehouse. Databricks Workflows orchestrates and Unity Catalog governs.
svg.text: Medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold) · file format at every stage
Unity Catalog · all stages stored in ADLS Gen2 (Databricks serverless compute)
External locations via Access Connector (managed identity)
